paired_comparison.bootstrap_protocol: 2000 paired scene-cluster multinomial resamples; RandomState seed 20260927; percentile 95% intervals; aggregate confusion counts before IoU.
paired_comparison.threshold_scope: No residual noninferiority/superiority threshold was predefined; the historical velocity -0.3 pp boundary is not applied here.
paired_comparison.interpretation: Single seed, fixed dataset and selected checkpoints. Equal student capacity/data/budget but different target representations/loss supervision. Validation subset reused for best selection and intervention analysis; shared run resumed with uncheckpointed work repeated. Intervals represent scene sampling conditional on these runs, not seed uncertainty or causal physical/velocity/storage benefit.

weight_audit_scope: Complete server CPU loading audit and SHA; local independent confusion-matrix reduction. No full local weight reload.
